answers.text: The reply puts the fixes in priority order and says what needs a person
answers.evidence: The reply ranks problems under 'Fix before launch' (1-5, ordered by how likely each is to make a member fail on a phone), then 'Fix soon after (important, but members can get through)' (6-12), then 'Smaller polish', with a 'Suggested order'. It names what it could not check ('I didn't test with VoiceOver or TalkBack, and I didn't test real 200% zoom on a device. The screen-reader notes come from reading the markup.') and says the journeys should be run on a real phone with VoiceOver before launch.

mapping.title: Closed days can be picked and are refused only at confirm, with no way to change the day
mapping.reason: The calendar 'lets you pick any day', including closed days; the closed Monday 12 October is caught only at the last step after the details are filled in, and the message has 'no link and no way to change the day'. That is D06: a closed day is selectable, refused three steps later on the confirm page, with only the browser leading back.

mapping.title: Days before the tool's 'available from' date can be reserved and confirmed
mapping.reason: The calendar allows 'days before the tool is even back', and the 'tool not available yet' case is never caught: an open day before 21 October 'would have confirmed'. That is D14 (days before the Available-from date are neither marked nor checked, and the reservation is confirmed).

mapping.title: Tool-page pick-up day and basket session can contradict each other unflagged
mapping.reason: Choosing the Saturday 10 October session for a tool set to Monday 12 October raised nothing, and the confirm page can show a per-tool pick-up day and a different session that contradict each other. That is D15: the day chosen on the tool page and the session chosen in the basket are never reconciled.

mapping.title: 8 px green dot is the only sign of an open day on phones
mapping.reason: Raised inside the fix: the 8 px green dot is 'the only sign of an open day at phone width' and hard to see for older eyes. That is D20 (below 480 px the word 'Open' gives way to an 8 px dot, so open days are easy to miss on a phone).

mapping.title: Hidden ten-minute basket hold; after it lapses Continue only says 'Something went wrong'
mapping.reason: The hold time is not shown ('Items are held for you while you finish'), and once it lapses Continue says 'Something went wrong. Try again.' every time, with no warning or way to get more time (2.2.1). That is D10; the fix it gives (show the hold, let members extend it, say plainly it expired and offer to hold again) fixes the defect.

mapping.title: Double tap on Confirm creates two reservations
mapping.reason: Confirm waits 1.5 s with no visible change and stays active; a double tap produced 'FT-4471 and FT-4472' for one drill. That is D12.

mapping.title: Basket Continue gives no busy feedback during its 1.2 s wait
mapping.reason: A different control from Confirm: Continue on the basket page also shows no visible change for 1.2 s, so a member on a phone cannot tell the tap registered and taps again or thinks the site has stalled. The ground truth has the silent wait only on Confirm (D12) and Continue's wrong error once the hold has lapsed (D10); a busy state on Continue fixes neither.

mapping.title: Basket not emptied after confirming, so the same tool can be reserved again
mapping.reason: After confirming the masthead still shows 'Basket (1)', 'so the same tool can be confirmed again'; the fix is to clear the basket and hold on success. That is D18.

mapping.title: Truncated card names make the two drills indistinguishable
mapping.reason: Names are cut to one line with an ellipsis, so at 375 px both drills read 'Cordless drill 18 V, co…' and the two-battery and one-battery drills cannot be told apart. That is D03.

mapping.title: On phones search and filters sit under the list, date filter behind an unlabelled icon
mapping.reason: Below 480 px the search box and filters are moved under all ten cards (about 2,100 px down) and the date filter is behind an unlabelled three-line icon that reads as a menu. Both halves are D01.

mapping.title: Dark-mode 'Available from' badge contrast about 3.1:1
mapping.reason: In dark mode #2f7d4a on #1d2622 is about 3.1:1 for 16 px bold text against the 4.5:1 needed (1.4.3). That is D04.

mapping.title: Brief 'Added to your basket' toast with no way on to the basket
mapping.reason: About the feedback after pressing 'Reserve this tool': the toast lasts 1.2 s with no link and the basket count has scrolled out of view. It does not say the member believes the tool is reserved, so it maps to D07, not D26.

mapping.title: A search with no matches leaves the old list and no message
mapping.reason: 'drill with two batteries' leaves the old list of 10 tools on screen and the hidden status message is never updated. That is D02.

mapping.title: Search matches only the exact phrase
mapping.reason: Raised in the fix 'match individual words rather than the exact phrase': a plain-words search for the two-battery drill finds nothing although that drill is listed, so members who search in their own words may decide the library hasn't got the tool. D02 is only the missing no-results message, and fixing it would not make the search find the drill.

mapping.title: Pick-up sessions shown in reverse date order
mapping.reason: row-reverse with wrap-reverse shows 28 October at the top and 10 October at the bottom while keyboard and screen-reader order stay chronological. That is D11.

mapping.title: Phone and membership number checks reject normal entries
mapping.reason: '07700 900 123', '+44 7700 900123' and 'ft-01234' are all rejected; the fix is to strip spaces, accept +44 and uppercase before checking. That is D17.

mapping.title: Loan-length dropdown traps the keyboard and won't close
mapping.reason: Tab loops inside the open list and Escape doesn't close it, which is the keyboard trap in D09. That tapping outside doesn't close it either is the same widget's missing dismissal, and the radio-button fix removes D09.

mapping.title: Three-tool limit not enforced
mapping.reason: The 'up to three tools' rule isn't enforced: 'You can add all ten.' That is D21.

mapping.title: 'Choose a pick-up day first' is not announced
mapping.reason: The error isn't linked to the calendar and focus jumps to the 9 October button, so a screen-reader user hears only the date. That is D19.

mapping.title: Results grid scrolls sideways at 320 px
mapping.reason: At 320 px the grid gives 346 px of content in a 320 px window because of minmax(330px, 1fr) (1.4.10). That is D05.

mapping.title: Fixed Reserve bar covers the footer and focused controls
mapping.reason: The fixed Reserve bar covers most of the footer, including the desk phone number, and can hide focused items when tabbing (2.4.11); the fix is bottom padding. That is D08.

mapping.title: Confirm page 'Change' link drops the chosen session
mapping.reason: The 'Change' link on the confirm page 'doesn't keep the session already chosen'. That is D13.

mapping.title: No skip link
mapping.reason: A bare checklist remark: the review shows no long block of repeated links, and no missing headings or landmarks, that a keyboard user would have to get past, and members mostly use phones, where a skip link plays no part. No harm to these users is shown.

mapping.title: Calendar does not show the month name
mapping.reason: The calendar is how a member picks the pick-up day; a grid of day numbers with no month leaves an older member on a phone to work out which month they are choosing in, and days become ambiguous if the grid runs past the end of the month. A minor but genuine orientation problem that no ground-truth defect covers.

mapping.title: Done page omits the loan length and return date
mapping.reason: The done page is the member's record of the reservation; without the loan length chosen or when the tool is due back, the member has nothing to check against and may return it late. No ground-truth defect covers it (the done-page defect D24 is the tool name read twice).
